note: Shrink-only baseline for check:trusted-keys (codebase analysis 2026-11-03, item B6). `prefixes` and `keys` are SERVICE_OWNED_KEY_PREFIXES and SERVICE_OWNED_KEYS in src/utils/reserved-keys.ts on 2026-11-04: a record one service keeps for an account now goes into that account's service namespace through serviceRecords() (src/services/service-records.ts), so an entry not listed here fails the gate. None of these moved in B6, because the account holder reads each of them today through GET /v1/memory, GET /v1/memory/:key and the exports, and no memory route reads the service namespace. `readsOutsideServiceRecords` is how many reads of a service-owned key the scan resolves outside serviceRecords(); it may only fall. When an entry leaves the list or the count falls, lower this file to match.
